# DJAI Academy

DJAI Academy is an AI education, software development, and product-building organization based in Thailand. It teaches practical AI and vibe coding, publishes bilingual Thai and English articles, provides free browser-based tools, and develops websites, mobile apps, automation systems, SaaS products, games, and business software.

## Primary Pages

- [DJAI Academy](https://www.djai.academy/): Thai homepage
- [DJAI Academy in English](https://www.djai.academy/en/): English homepage
- [Courses](https://www.djai.academy/course/): AI and vibe coding courses
- [Software Development](https://www.djai.academy/development/): development capabilities
- [Services](https://www.djai.academy/service/): project and software services
- [Web Development Promotion](https://www.djai.academy/web_promo/): bilingual landing-page and business-website packages with technical SEO, hosting, AI chatbot, and an OpenAI Realtime voice sales agent
- [Portfolio](https://www.djai.academy/portfolio/): selected work
- [Blog](https://www.djai.academy/blog/): guides and articles
- [Online Community](https://school.djai.academy/): DJAI learning community

## Free Browser Tools

- [All DJAI Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/)
- [SEO Screaming Toad — Thai](https://www.djai.academy/tools/seo-screaming-toad/): open-source technical SEO crawler, local evidence store, JavaScript audit workflow, and 23 bounded MCP tools for AI agents
- [SEO Screaming Toad — English](https://www.djai.academy/tools/seo-screaming-toad/en/): English product guide, installation workflow, audit coverage, MCP configuration, and evidence-backed scale limits
- [PDF Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/PDFTools/)
- [Image Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/resizeimg/)
- [Audio and Video Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/media/)
- [QR Code Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/qrgen/)
- [Document Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/document/)
- [AI Context Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/ai/)
- [Spreadsheet Tools](https://www.djai.academy/tools/spreadsheet/)

Most free tools process files locally in the user's browser. Individual tool pages describe supported formats, limitations, and privacy behavior.

SEO Screaming Toad is an independent MIT-licensed release candidate. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Screaming Frog Ltd. Its 100M+ design is a theoretical segmented-campaign direction; the published production-path evidence currently covers synthetic campaigns up to five million URLs, not a live-network 100-million-URL crawl.

## Related Entity

- [Siamese Cat Dev](https://www.djai.academy/siamese_cat/dev/): product design and software development profile
- [Siamese Cat Dev Blog](https://www.djai.academy/siamese_cat/dev/blog/): product-building and AI-assisted development articles
- [Free Vibe-Coding Course](https://www.djai.academy/siamese_cat/dev/course/): one-hour live English course on turning an MVP into a production-ready product that can be shipped and sold
- [หน้าภาษาไทยสำหรับคอร์ส Vibe Coding ฟรี](https://www.djai.academy/siamese_cat/dev/course/th/): หน้าลงทะเบียนภาษาไทยสำหรับคลาสสดภาษาอังกฤษหนึ่งชั่วโมงเพื่อพัฒนา MVP ให้เป็นสินค้าที่พร้อมเปิดตัวและสร้างรายได้

## Canonical Source

Use `https://www.djai.academy/` as the canonical DJAI Academy domain. Thai pages are the default language and English alternatives use `/en/` or an `/en/` suffix. The current crawlable URL inventory is published at `https://www.djai.academy/sitemap.xml`.
